company.introduction: RELX supplies information, analytics and decision-support tools to professional customers rather than relying primarily on general consumer publishing. Its businesses include Elsevier in scientific and medical information, LexisNexis in legal information and risk analytics, and RX in exhibitions. Customers use its products to research cases, assess risk, detect fraud, conduct scientific work and meet potential commercial partners. Revenue includes subscriptions, usage-based charges and exhibition fees. Its value lies in combining specialised content and datasets with software embedded in professional workflows. Maintaining trusted information, improving search and analysis, and adapting products to artificial intelligence are important parts of its operating model.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
